title: 竹里馆
author: Wang Wei

translation: i sit alone in the quiet bamboo grove
plucking the lute and singing a long clear call
deep in the forest no one knows i am here
only the bright moon comes to shine on me

appreciation: A man sits hidden in a bamboo grove, playing the lute and whistling long and clear, with no audience but the moon. The darkness of the deep forest is answered by moonlight, and the music fills the silence without breaking it. The poem matters because it makes solitude look chosen and bright, a signature moment of Wang Wei's quiet Buddhist serenity.
